text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًۭا

baseline.text: Bilgin olmayan şeyin ardına düşme. Çünkü işitme, görme ve gönül, bunların hepsinden hesap sorulur.

findings.text: Bilgisizce bir izin ardına düşmek, işitme ve görmenin sağladığı kanıtı iç karara kadar taşıyan sorumlu zinciri aşar; iddia ancak bu aşamalar hesabını verebildiği ölçüde ilerleyebilir.

activation_trace.role: Following an effect supplies the literal pursuit image and frames the command as movement along an evidentiary trail.
A distinguishing mark that guides supplies the criterion by which a trace becomes warranted knowledge.
Auditory apprehension supplies one incoming evidence channel whose report must remain answerable.
Ocular seeing supplies a second evidence channel and keeps observation distinct from conclusion.
The heart viewed through inward heat supplies the interpretive and affective stage where inputs become conviction.
Asking and requesting supplies the audit action applied to the completed evidence chain.

changed_reading.after: Do not advance along a claim's trail unless perception, recognition, and inward judgment can answer for how it became knowledge.
changed_reading.before: Do not concern yourself with a matter you do not know.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition on following without knowledge is followed by the joint accountability of hearing, sight, and heart.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following is movement along a trace; knowledge requires a distinguishing sign; hearing and sight acquire inputs; the heated inward heart interprets them; questioning audits the resulting chain. The verse therefore separates receipt, recognition, interpretation, and commitment instead of treating any sensation as knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A hear-or-look episode that yields no actual perception and proceeds by conjecture supplies the verse's precise failure mode.
Literal seeing marks the positive perceptual content that conjecture cannot simply replace.
Disclosure of a thing to the knower supplies the threshold that a mere sensory hint has not met.
Trace-following turns the unresolved hint into consequential pursuit rather than passive uncertainty.

changed_reading.after: Do not promote a heard or seen hint into knowledge when perception has failed and conjecture is doing the hidden work.
changed_reading.before: Avoid subjects about which you possess no information.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Hearing and sight are named inside a sentence that denies knowledge, so sensory occurrence cannot by itself close the epistemic gap.
baseline_models.mechanism: A rare hearing branch describes hearing or looking, failing to perceive anything, and then acting by conjecture. That branch makes the coordinated hearing and sight an explicit failure test: a stimulus may occur while knowledge is still absent, and pursuit begins when conjecture silently fills the missing perception.

activation_trace.role: Accusation, false testimony, and tracking faults supply the concrete social harm of unsupported pursuit.
Public repute and circulated report supply the transmission channel by which an unsupported claim spreads.
Inward insight, verification, and self-witness supply both a checking capacity and evidence against the speaker.
The inwardly heated heart supplies the motive and affect that can convert hearsay into committed accusation.
Inquiry supplies accountability for each handoff from hearing to endorsement and repetition.

changed_reading.after: Do not receive, endorse, or circulate a reputation-harming claim whose sensory basis and inward motive cannot withstand inquiry.
changed_reading.before: Do not accept an unsupported proposition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening verb can branch into accusation, false testimony, and fault-tracking, while hearing can branch into public reputation and circulation.
baseline_models.mechanism: An unverified report enters through hearing, is colored by inward motive, and is repeated as accusation or fault-finding. Sight and inner insight are possible checks, while questioning makes reception, verification, intent, and propagation separately answerable.

activation_trace.role: Following a trace anchors the revised model in the focus prohibition's evidentiary movement.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the context's claim of superior access to what humans cannot directly inspect.
What is within the self as intellect and inward apprehension supplies the hidden domain at issue.
Knowledge of report and inward reality supplies a mode of access deeper than an external human observation.
Penetrating insight and verification supply the context's contrast with limited human sight.

changed_reading.after: Keep human claims within the reach of human evidence, especially refusing to treat another person's hidden motive as something hearing or sight has established.
changed_reading.before: Require adequate evidence before following a claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context reserves knowledge of what lies within selves to the superior knower and later joins expert knowledge of inner affairs with penetrating sight. Against that frame, the questioned human faculties have a bounded jurisdiction: they may report accessible traces but may not claim another person's hidden motive as though it were directly seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies superior knowledge of selves and expert inward knowledge joined to sight; I infer a jurisdictional contrast with the questioned human faculties. A live alternative is that 17:25 and 17:30 only reassure and describe provision, without restricting human claims about motives.
structural_cues: 17:25 places superior knowing over what is within selves, and 17:30 repeats expert knowing and sight before 17:36 audits human faculties.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion gathers every named faculty into the same entrusted obligation.
Completion without deficiency supplies the standard for faithfully discharging an entrusted report.
Preserving and repeatedly attending to an entrusted matter supplies the covenantal custody model.
Questioning attaches auditability to the covenant immediately before the same audit reaches the faculties.
Questioning in the focus transfers the adjacent accountability pattern onto hearing, sight, and heart.

changed_reading.after: Hearing, sight, and heart are entrusted witnesses; receiving, preserving, and reporting through them is a covenant-like duty that must be fulfilled intact.
changed_reading.before: The faculties are sources of evidence that will be checked.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, a covenant is to be fulfilled and is itself placed under questioning; the focus then repeats the accountability construction for hearing, sight, and heart. The faculties therefore read not only as evidence channels but as entrusted witnesses whose custody and reporting must be discharged without deficit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant preservation, complete fulfillment, and the immediate repetition of questioning; I infer that the adjacency lends fiduciary structure to the faculties. A live alternative is a rhetorical echo that links accountability generally without making the faculties a covenant.
structural_cues: 17:34 and 17:36 repeat the same copular accountability construction with only the accountable subject changing.
The measure command in 17:35 stands between covenant accountability and faculty accountability, reinforcing faithful discharge rather than bare possession.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark supplies the focus-side object that the contextual measuring procedure must assess.
Comparison between two matters supplies deliberate comparison rather than immediate acceptance.
Estimating a thing by weight supplies proportional assessment of evidentiary force.
The balance supplies an external standard against which competing evidence is tested.
Straightness, moderation, and equilibrium qualify the standard as calibrated rather than tilted.
Return to an eventual outcome supplies a consequence check on the conclusion produced.

changed_reading.after: Produce warranted knowledge by comparing evidence, weighing it proportionately, testing it against a straight standard, and checking the conclusion's outcome before following it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding cluster of measuring, weighing, straightness, and outcome supplies a procedure for the focus command. Evidence is to be compared, assigned proportionate weight, tested against an upright standard, and judged by what the conclusion becomes; unsupported pursuit is failed epistemic measurement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete commercial measuring procedure; I supply the analogy that evidence can be compared and weighted by the same procedural pattern. A live alternative is that 17:35 and 17:36 remain adjacent but independent ethical duties.
structural_cues: 17:35 immediately precedes the focus and concentrates full measure, weighing, a straight standard, and final outcome in one sequence.

activation_trace.role: The inwardly heated heart anchors the model in affective processing that can harden fear into action.
Fear joined with awe supplies a powerful forecast that can motivate action without establishing its premise.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the positive evidentiary threshold for justified action.
Compelling proof supplies an authorization that must be more than inward certainty.
Crossing the limit supplies a second constraint even after a right and authority are present.

changed_reading.after: Do not let fear or heated conviction cross into irreversible action until reality-matching evidence and valid authority are present, and do not exceed their limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context contrasts irreversible killing driven by feared scarcity with action bounded by truth-matched right, compelling authority, and a prohibition on excess. The focus rule becomes the procedural threshold between an affective forecast and consequential action: fear may alert the heart, but it cannot substitute for knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fear-driven killing and a later right-proof-limit sequence; I infer that 17:36 generalizes the evidentiary threshold before irreversible conduct. A live alternative is that the homicide rules remain specific cases and the focus concerns belief or report alone.
structural_cues: Within the same pericope, 17:31 names fear before killing, while 17:33 names right, authority, and excess around killing.

activation_trace.role: False testimony and accusation anchor bodily overreach back in the focus as epistemic and verbal invention.
Piercing and traversing the earth supplies the literal image of access the embodied knower does not possess.
Fabricating a lie supplies the lexical pivot from impossible physical penetration to invented epistemic reach.
Reaching a limit or goal supplies the bounded horizon that hearing and sight cannot simply exceed.
A high solid mass supplies the resistant scale against which human reach is exposed as limited.
Self-exaltation and overreaching supply the attitude that converts limited access into an unlimited claim.

changed_reading.after: Treat the limits of hearing, sight, and inward judgment as embodied limits; claiming access beyond them is an epistemic version of trying to pierce the earth or outgrow the mountains.
changed_reading.before: Do not assert what your evidence does not support.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse after the focus places the knower back inside a body that cannot penetrate the ground or attain mountain scale. One branch of penetrating also turns toward fabricated speech, creating a pivot from physical overreach to epistemic invention. Unsupported pursuit is thus a form of self-exalting reach beyond the body's actual access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily non-penetration, non-attainment, and a branch from penetration to fabricated speech; I infer that physical scale figures epistemic scope. A live alternative is that 17:37 addresses arrogance in walking without commenting on knowledge.
structural_cues: 17:37 immediately follows the audit of human faculties with two explicit statements of what the human body cannot penetrate or reach.

activation_trace.role: Comprehensive inclusion supplies the focus-side gathering of all three faculties.
Questioning turns the gathered faculties into an audit interface rather than a static list.
Comprehensive inclusion supplies the context-side gathering of the preceding conduct into one evaluated whole.
Aversion opposed to approval supplies the evaluative verdict applied to the gathered conduct.
Sovereignty and mastery supply the authority before whom both conduct and faculties are answerable.

changed_reading.after: The verse is the audit layer of the surrounding ethical code: the channels by which every duty is perceived, judged, and carried into action are themselves accountable.
changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated maxim about intellectual caution.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus comprehensively gathers the faculties, and 17:38 comprehensively gathers the preceding acts under evaluative displeasure before the sovereign Lord. The paired totalizations align an ethical catalog with its human audit interface: hearing, sight, and heart are how the preceding duties are perceived, reasoned about, and enacted.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two nearby comprehensive gatherings and a sovereign evaluation; I infer that the faculty audit operationalizes the whole code. A live alternative is that 17:38 gathers only deeds and that the focus remains one independent prohibition among them.
structural_cues: The totalizer in 17:36 gathers the faculties, while the totalizer in 17:38 gathers the surrounding ethical catalog.
The focus sits inside the catalog rather than outside it as an abstract epistemological aside.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of a thing to the knower anchors the model in the focus's positive knowledge threshold.
Understanding, accepting, and acting on heard communication supplies a receptive channel that still requires warranted content.
Imparting knowledge in hidden form supplies a legitimate source not reducible to direct ocular observation.
Divine report and inspiration identify the contextual disclosure as warranted rather than conjectural.
Wisdom as knowledge that hits the right judgment supplies the quality test for received disclosure.

changed_reading.after: The rule tests warrant and accountable reception, not sensory immediacy; trustworthy disclosure and wisdom can yield knowledge, while every receiving and interpreting faculty remains answerable.
changed_reading.before: Only what one directly hears or sees can count as knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verse retrospectively identifies the sequence as knowledge imparted in hidden form and as right-aiming wisdom. That prevents the focus from becoming a direct-sense-only rule: hearing, sight, and heart are accountable channels, but warranted knowledge may also be received through trustworthy disclosure that is not independently visible.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden imparting, divine report, and right-aiming knowledge; I infer that this is a positive counterexample to an empiricist reading of 17:36. A live alternative is that the exception belongs specifically to the prophetic recipient and does not generalize to other reported knowledge.
structural_cues: 17:39 retrospectively labels the surrounding instruction as revealed wisdom immediately after the focus's knowledge rule.

remaining_uncertainties: The covenantal reading depends on treating the repeated accountability construction as more than a general rhetorical echo.
The transfer from commercial measurement to evidentiary weighting is coherent but remains a reader-supplied analogy.
The non-dominant hidden-extraction inventory should remain exploratory and should not control lexical translation.
The revelation correction is certain for the addressed recipient but may not license every form of reported knowledge.
strongest_changes: The repeated accountability construction around the covenant recasts hearing, sight, and heart as entrusted witnesses.
The adjacent measure, weight, straight-standard, and outcome sequence turns epistemic restraint into a calibration procedure.
Superior knowledge of interiors limits human motive claims, while revealed wisdom prevents a direct-sense-only reading.
The post-focus limits on penetration and reach embody the humility required by bounded human evidence.
summary.what_was_special: The rare hearing branch that joins hearing, looking, failed perception, and conjectural action closely mirrors the focus verse's internal architecture. The covenant and metrology sequences then convert that architecture from a generic warning into an inspectable procedure of custody, calibration, and audit.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out gently and secretly supplies an image of examination extracting concealed sensory and inward traces.
Linked connection supplies an image of the extracted traces being assembled into an accountable chain.
Trace-following anchors the extraction image back in the verse's pursuit of an evidentiary sequence.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the audit draws hidden traces out of each faculty and links them into the trail the person chose to follow.
changed_reading.before: The faculties will simply be asked about their use.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped inventory for the questioning root rather than the ordinary request sense. It remains anchored at the focus's accountability word and uses explicit packet branches for hidden drawing and connection. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for interrogation, not as a replacement lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final accountability word is packet-mapped not only to asking but also to a root inventory of hidden drawing-out and linked sequence.

activation_trace.role: Accusation and false testimony supply the harmful informational content being propagated.
Public repute and broadcast report supply the social network through which the claim travels.
Speech that becomes widespread among people supplies the propagation stage beyond private belief.
Divulging a secret or report supplies the scattering image that makes transmission itself accountable.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also governs the topology of transmission: an unsupported report becomes more culpable as it is scattered from hearing into public speech.
changed_reading.before: The verse governs whether an individual privately believes a claim.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain activation from resource scattering to information circulation, so it is more specific than the surface spending context. It remains valid because the context root has an explicit branch for divulging secrets or conversation, while the focus independently supplies public repute and accusation. Downstream prose should qualify it as a network-propagation analogy, not identify all spending language with speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins unsupported accusation with hearing's public circulation, allowing the earlier scattering branch to expose propagation as a separate accountable act.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Unsupported following converts perception into liable testimony.** `ق ف و:B001/B004` follows a trace but also fault-tracks or slanders; `ع ل م:B001/B002` knows through clarity and marks; `س م ع:B001/B003`, `ب ص ر:B001/B002`, and `ف ء د:B002` form hearing, sight, and the inner kindling. The ban targets movement behind an unverified trace, then audits the organs that could verify it. I infer claims become culpable when inferential pursuit outruns perceptual warrant. Knowledge here is disciplined chain-of-evidence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:47 and 17:101 show hearers replacing evidence with a “bewitched” label. Those scenes concretized `ق ف و:B004`: unsupported following becomes accusation despite direct audition and clear signs.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Knowing as an accountable evidence pipeline.** Lexical evidence: `ق ف و B001` (following a trace and succession) in `تَقْفُ`, and `ف ء د B002` (the heart as an inner kindling) in `ٱلْفُؤَادَ`. Structural cue: 17:33–35 requires justified force, guarded trust, and exact measure; this ayah sequences hearing, sight, and heart before 17:37 rejects bodily self-mismeasurement and 17:41 shows recitation increasing flight. Assigned role: hearing and sight supply traces, while the inner kindling integrates and energizes them into commitment. Abductive move: the organs and their questioning are supplied; I infer that each mediating stage is accountable because unsupported pursuit can convert a faint trace into action. Reading change: `لَا تَقْفُ` establishes epistemic due process: do not follow a trail farther than the evidence channels can answer for.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:41 supplied the most diagnostic later case: varied recitation increasing flight demonstrates how an unanswerable perceptual pipeline can turn additional traces into additional error.

words.gloss_range: coordinating continuation that keeps the prohibition inside the surrounding command sequence
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the ayah continue the prior chain rather than open as an isolated maxim. At the surface opening, connection and prohibition arrive together, and the connection carries the reader from fair measure and weighing into epistemic restraint. The rule about following claims therefore stands inside the same ethical architecture as the surrounding prohibitions.

topics.headline: coordinated command-chain continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the knowledge command as another member of the sustained prohibition chain, not as a detached saying.
topics.reason: The opening conjunction coordinates the full prohibition with the preceding sequence, and the local clause evidence treats {{ar:وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا}} ({{tr:wa-la taqfu ma}}) as one verbal prohibition.

topics.headline: boundary bridge from measurement to epistemics
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that commercial justice and knowledge discipline are joined before any new theme is explained.
topics.reason: The connective marks continuity across the verse boundary, moving from the previous commercial-command closure into a new knowledge-command clause.

topics.headline: compact wa-la surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears connection and prohibition arrive together at the surface opening.
topics.reason: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is a proclitic immediately followed by prohibitive {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}), making continuation and negative command a compact opening unit.

words.gloss_range: prohibitive negation governing the following jussive verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}) is not simple negation; it is prohibitive and governs the jussive form of {{ar:تَقْفُ}} ({{tr:taqfu}}). It remains a visible separate particle before the clipped verb, so the reader can see the source of command force. The ayah first gives a command to stop, then defines the thing that must not be followed: whatever lacks object-specific knowledge.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: jussive verb governed by the prohibitive particle

topics.headline: prohibitive particle governs jussive pursuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the prohibition is grammatically encoded in the verb form, not only inferred from translation.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}) as jussive negation governing {{ar:تَقْفُ}} ({{tr:taqfu}}), and the local clause is a prohibition.

topics.headline: negative command creates epistemic boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that pursuing without knowledge is framed as a prohibited act before it is explained as a risk.
topics.reason: The first clause begins with negative command force, and the object clause later supplies the epistemic boundary.

topics.headline: visible particle before clipped verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can see the source of the command force as a separate particle joined to the shortened verb.
topics.reason: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}) remains written as its own governing particle before the jussive verb, while the phrase is heard as a compact prohibition.

words.gloss_range: following, tracking, or pursuing a trace; locally narrowed to unevidenced epistemic pursuit under prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:تَقْفُ}} ({{tr:taqfu}}) makes the forbidden act feel like tracking a trail, not merely holding an opinion. The object {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) is explicit, so the command is not a blanket ban on following; it forbids pursuing a matter whose evidentiary track has not become knowledge for the addressee. Its singular address individualizes that responsibility, its jussive clipped surface and accepted variant contrast formally stop the action, and the rare root echo with questioning at 37:24 lets the opening pursuit anticipate the ayah's final audit.
words.root_gloss_range: tracking or following a trace, with a rare Quranic profile; local grammar selects prohibited pursuit of an object defined by lack of knowledge

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative object governed by the tracking verb

topics.headline: jussive verb with explicit object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a commanded non-action aimed at a defined object, not a vague warning against curiosity.
topics.reason: The verb is jussive under prohibitive {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:la}}), and {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) with its relative clause is the direct object.

topics.headline: physical tracking image narrowed to epistemic pursuit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that unevidenced pursuit is pictured as walking behind a trail whose proof is missing.
topics.reason: The root image of tracking survives, but the local object clause narrows it to following claims or matters without object-specific knowledge rather than physical footprint tracking.

topics.headline: clipped jussive and variant contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the forbidden pursuit shortened at the same point the command forbids it.
topics.reason: The Hafs surface is apocopated under the prohibitive particle, and the supplied variant readings make that truncation visible without changing the local prohibition.

topics.headline: individualized addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices responsibility narrow from communal ethics to the single person who chooses whether to follow a claim.
topics.reason: The form carries second-person singular agreement, while the broader passage has moved through plural communal commands.

topics.headline: rare tracking root anticipates questioning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare tracking verb points forward to being stopped and questioned, especially through the echo with 37:24.
topics.reason: The root is low-occurrence locally and the explicit 37:24 echo links pursuit or stopping with questioning without overriding the local syntax.

topics.headline: tracking action grammatically stopped
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees root image, prohibition, clipped form, and variant contrast converge around the halted act of following.
topics.reason: The synthesis row is retained because each layer is locally licensed by the verb's grammar, root profile, and supplied variant evidence.

words.gloss_range: open relative object whose following clause defines the prohibited domain
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) supplies the object of {{ar:تَقْفُ}} ({{tr:taqfu}}), but it does so as an open relative slot. The forbidden object is not a named class like rumor or testimony; it is whatever the following clause defines as lacking knowledge for the addressee.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: verb whose object is supplied by the relative pronoun

topics.headline: relative pronoun fills object slot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the object of pursuit is clause-shaped, with its epistemic status built into its definition.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) and its relative clause as the explicit object of the verb.

topics.headline: open object field defined by ignorance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the prohibition travels with any matter that fails the knowledge test, not just one preselected topic.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun is open-ended, and the following negated knowledge clause supplies the limiting criterion.

topics.headline: bare form avoids narrowing the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the object remains portable enough to cover any pursued matter that lacks evidence.
topics.reason: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}) bears no article or suffix, so it does not pre-classify the object before the knowledge clause defines it.

words.gloss_range: defective verb of negation; locally negates the addressee's knowledge relation to the pursued matter
words.prose: {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) builds the inner condition that defines the forbidden object. It negates the existence of {{ar:عِلْمٌ}} ({{tr:ilmun}}) for the addressee concerning the matter, so the ayah is not forbidding pursuit in general but pursuit where the knowledge relation is absent. The same negated-possession frame also recalls 17:65, where authority is denied; here the denied possession is knowledge, and the clause tightens around that absence before the accountability turn.
words.root_gloss_range: fixed negating verb with other lexical branches in dictionary evidence; only the copular negation branch is active here

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: knowledge noun whose absence is negated by laysa

topics.headline: defective verb structures no-knowledge clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that ignorance is framed as a complete predication, not a loose descriptive label.
topics.reason: The local syntax makes {{ar:عِلْمٌ}} ({{tr:ilmun}}) the negated nominal element with {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}) and {{ar:بِهِ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) as complements.

topics.headline: state of absent knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threshold is absence of knowledge, not merely weak confidence.
topics.reason: The negating defective verb establishes a stative no-knowledge condition inside the relative clause.

topics.headline: same-surah negated-possession echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shared negated-possession frame: no authority at 17:65 and no knowledge here.
topics.reason: The concrete 17:65 comparison uses the same {{ar:لَيْسَ لَكَ}} ({{tr:laysa laka}}) frame, while the local complement changes the denied possession to knowledge.

topics.headline: inner negation narrows the sound of license
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the object clause close around non-knowledge before the ayah turns to accountability.
topics.reason: The {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) clause is the defining content of {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), and the sound sequence tightens before the knowledge noun lands.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus second-person suffix marking the addressee as the one lacking knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:لَكَ}} ({{tr:laka}}) makes the knowledge test personal. The ayah does not ask whether some knowledge exists somewhere; it asks whether the matter stands in a knowledge relation to the one who is about to follow it. Its second-person suffix keeps the command and the knowledge condition aimed at the same individual, and its position before the knowledge noun foregrounds the accountable person before the criterion appears.

topics.headline: knowledge must belong to the addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that hearsay or remote availability does not satisfy the command; the knowledge relation is personal.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase marks the addressee as the one for whom knowledge is absent in the {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) predication.

topics.headline: same individual remains addressed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the command and the knowledge condition aimed at the same individual.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix repeats the addressee encoded in the verb's subject agreement.

topics.headline: addressee foregrounded before knowledge noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader meets the accountable person before the knowledge noun arrives.
topics.reason: The fused preposition-pronoun appears before {{ar:بِهِ عِلْمٌ}} ({{tr:bihi ilmun}}), foregrounding personal relation before the noun.

words.gloss_range: preposition plus suffix marking the exact matter about which knowledge is required
words.prose: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) pins knowledge to the very matter being pursued. Its suffix points back to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), while the preposition marks knowledge-about rather than mere association; the possible reinforcing force of the bāʾ is retained as exact emphasis inside that local construction. The same object will later be carried into the accountability clause, so knowledge-about becomes questioning-about.

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: relative object resumed by the attached pronoun

topics.headline: knowledge must be about the pursued matter
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that general confidence is not enough; knowledge must concern this object.
topics.reason: {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) is the complement of {{ar:عِلْمٌ}} ({{tr:ilmun}}), marking the epistemic domain.

topics.headline: suffix routes back to the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same object from pursuit to knowledge test and later into accountability.
topics.reason: The suffix refers back to {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:ma}}), keeping the pursued matter present without repetition.

topics.headline: reinforcing bāʾ kept inside domain marking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the lack of knowledge as exact and emphatic, while the grammar still keeps the phrase as knowledge-about.
topics.reason: The bāʾ zāʾida analysis can reinforce the negation, but local attachment evidence still makes the phrase the complement of {{ar:عِلْمٌ}} ({{tr:ilmun}}), so the topic is narrowed to emphatic domain marking.

words.gloss_range: knowledge; locally an indefinite negated noun marking any object-specific knowledge at all
words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٌ}} ({{tr:ilmun}}) closes the prohibited object's definition by naming the missing criterion. Because it is indefinite under negation, the bar is stark: not even any object-specific knowledge is present, and raw perception or exposure to data has not yet become verified knowledge. The word also becomes the ayah's hinge: no-knowledge humility at 2:32 and limited human knowledge at 17:85 frame the discipline, while absent knowledge in this clause leads to the questioning of faculties in the second and makes concrete conduct enter epistemic audit.
